result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org. TPH2 (Q8IWU9): neuron-specific enzyme that converts L-tryptophan into 5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan, the rate-limiting step in serotonin production, with Fe2+ as cofactor and O2 and tetrahydrobiopterin as cosubstrates; brain specific. DDC (P20711): decarboxylates L-5-hydroxytryptophan to serotonin and CO2; pyridoxal 5'-phosphate cofactor. SLC18A2 (Q05940), VMAT2: electrogenic antiporter that exchanges one cationic monoamine, including serotonin, for two intravesicular protons, using the proton gradient of the V-type ATPase to accumulate monoamines in vesicles before release by exocytosis; strongly inhibited by reserpine and tetrabenazine. SLC6A4 (P31645), serotonin transporter: cotransports serotonin with one Na+ in exchange for one K+ and possibly one proton, from the extracellular compartment to the cytosol; mediates uptake from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic terminal, terminating synaptic signalling; ensures rapid high-affinity uptake of serotonin from plasma into platelets, which store it in dense granules and release it on stimulation; expressed in platelets. MAOA (P21397): FAD enzyme of the mitochondrial outer membrane that catalyses oxidative deamination of neurotransmitters and preferentially oxidises serotonin: serotonin + O2 + H2O = (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetaldehyde + H2O2 + NH4+. ALDH9A1 (P49189): (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetaldehyde + NAD+ + H2O = (5-hydroxyindol-3-yl)acetate + NADH + 2 H+, with experimental evidence.
